What it does

Your classes, homework and notes in one place

Saxon Planner is a school planner built around your schedule. Add your classes once, paste your Schoology link, and your assignments show up on their own.

Courses

Every class, and what's coming up in it.

Each class gets a card with its period and the next things due. Odd periods meet on Green days and even periods on Gold days, and the planner keeps track of which is which.

  • Periods and lunchSet each class's period and lunch once, and every day's schedule fills in.
  • Add in secondsType a line in a class's card and it's due at that class's next meeting.
  • Drag to fixMove a task to another day, or onto another class's card.

Calendar

Day, week and month, synced with Schoology.

Paste your Schoology calendar (iCal) link once. Assignments and tests import automatically and land in the right class. The calendar already knows the school year's holidays, breaks and early release days.

  • TodayToday and the next school day, with period times, your lunch and what's due.
  • Week and monthSee the week class by class, or drag items to another day in Month.
  • Your edits stayImporting only adds. It never undoes what you changed or deleted.

Assignments and To-Do

One list of what's left, and notes for everything else.

Assignments lists everything not done yet, oldest first, and you cross things off as you finish them. To-Do holds sticky notes for the rest: reminders, forms to turn in, things to bring.

  • Overdue at a glanceOpen the overdue column to see what was due today or earlier.
  • Sticky notesColor them, give them a class, or turn an assignment into a note.
  • UndoCrossed off the wrong thing? Ctrl+Z brings it back.

Resources

Documents and links for each class, shared by classmates.

Keep study guides, notes and links under the class they belong to. Make one public and, once it's approved, anyone taking that class can import it from the public library.

  • Documents and linksWrite guides with headings, lists and highlights, or save a link or a PDF.
  • Public librarySearch by class, title or text, and import what helps.
  • Reviewed firstPublic resources are checked before anyone else can see them.

Games

Singleplayer, social and multiplayer games for a break.

Chess, Solitaire, Poker, Gartic Phone and plenty more, in one list you can search. Star the ones you like and they stay at the top.

  • Play as a guestYour progress is kept in this browser under a guest code.
  • Sign in to saveSigned in, progress saves to your account. A guest code moves its progress over once, in Settings.
  • MultiplayerUnlocks after you share your referral link and one person signs up with it.
  • Hide instantlyPress H in any game to close it.

Tools

A GPA calculator that weights classes the FCPS way, Desmos, a clock that counts down the period, a physics table helper and a breathing timer for study breaks.

Chat

Message friends one on one, or start a group of up to 20. Only people on your friends list can message you directly.

Rewards

Share your link. Each person who signs up with it moves you up a rank and unlocks something new, like custom page colors, colored notes and Crown avatars.

Start with your classes

All it takes is a username and a password. Add your classes, paste your Schoology link, and you're set.
